rows.analysis: 此字為現代透明度較低的歷史借詞，源自古法語 prison，最終源自拉丁語 prēnsiōn-, prēnsiō（意為「抓住、逮捕」，由 prēnsus 衍生）。在英語中主要作名詞，指關押罪犯的建築物，或引申為限制自由的處境。
rows.definition: 1. a building where criminals are kept as a punishment; 2. a place or situation that severely restricts freedom.

example.eng: He was sent to prison for robbery.
example.ch: 他因搶劫而被送進監獄。

example.eng: Her unhappy marriage felt like a prison.
example.ch: 她不幸的婚姻感覺像個牢籠。

rows.analysis: 此字由名詞 prison 加上表示人的名詞字尾 -er 構成，指在監獄服刑的人或在戰爭中被捕獲的軍民。構詞透明，語義從 prison（監獄）自然延伸為「身處監獄或受拘禁的人」。
rows.definition: 1. a person kept in prison as a punishment or while awaiting trial; 2. a person captured and held by an enemy, especially in wartime.

example.eng: The prisoner tried to escape from his cell.
example.ch: 那名囚犯試圖從牢房逃跑。

example.eng: Several soldiers were taken prisoner.
example.ch: 數名士兵被俘。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 prīvātus（意為「個別的、私人的」，源於 prīvāre「使分離、剝奪」）。在現代英語中主要作形容詞，指屬於個人而非公眾的屬性，或作名詞指軍階最低的列兵。形容詞與名詞雖相關，但根據詞性分開原則，此處輸出最常見的形容詞 row。
rows.definition: 1. belonging to or for the use of a particular person or group only; 2. confidential or secret; 3. of or relating to the lowest rank in the army.

example.eng: This is my private property.
example.ch: 這是我的私人財產。

example.eng: We had a private conversation.
example.ch: 我們進行了一次私下談話。

example.eng: He served as a private in the infantry.
example.ch: 他曾在步兵團擔任列兵。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 prise（意為「抓住、獲得」），經由中古英語進入現代英語。主要作名詞，指在競賽中贏得的獎項，或引申為值得追求與爭奪的高價值珍寶。
rows.definition: 1. something of value won in a competition, contest, or lottery; 2. something worth striving for or highly valued.

example.eng: She won first prize in the art competition.
example.ch: 她贏得了美術比賽的第一名。

example.eng: The painting was the main prize of the collection.
example.ch: 這幅畫是該收藏中最珍貴的藏品。

rows.analysis: 此字為拉丁語借詞，由字首 prō-（向前）與 ducere（引導、帶領）複合而成的 prōdūcere（引出、生產）演變而來。作為及物動詞，核心義為將原材料轉化為成品、自然長出農作物，或在文娛領域統籌製作作品。
rows.definition: 1. to make or manufacture from components or raw materials; 2. to cause a natural product, crop, or substance to come into existence; 3. to oversee and finance the making of a film, play, or record.

example.eng: The factory produces cars and trucks.
example.ch: 這家工廠生產汽車和卡車。

example.eng: This region produces high-quality wine.
example.ch: 這個地區出產高品質的葡萄酒。

example.eng: She is producing a new television series.
example.ch: 她正在製作一部新的電視劇。

rows.analysis: 此字為動詞 produce 的名詞形式，源自拉丁語 prōductiōn-（延伸、生產）。結構上由詞根與名詞字尾 -ion 結合而成。指生產的行為、過程、產量，或指電影、舞台劇等最終產出的藝術作品。
rows.definition: 1. the action of making or manufacturing from components or raw materials; 2. the total amount of goods produced; 3. a film, play, or broadcast prepared for public exhibition.

example.eng: Car production has increased this year.
example.ch: 今年的汽車產量有所增加。

example.eng: The factory halted production due to a strike.
example.ch: 該工廠因罷工而暫停生產。

example.eng: The theater's new production of Hamlet was a success.
example.ch: 該劇院新製作的《哈姆雷特》非常成功。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 prōgressus（向前走，由 prō-「向前」+ gradi「走」組成）。在英語中作名詞，指朝著目標推進、發展或空間上的向前移動。
rows.definition: 1. forward or onward movement toward a destination or goal; 2. development or improvement over time.

example.eng: We are making good progress on the project.
example.ch: 我們這個專案進展順利。

example.eng: Scientists track the progress of the disease.
example.ch: 科學家追蹤該疾病的發展情況。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 prōiectum（投射出去的事物，由 prō-「向前」+ iacere「投擲」組成）。作名詞時，指經過精心規劃、旨在達成特定目標的任務、工程或學術研究計畫。
rows.definition: 1. an individual or collaborative enterprise that is carefully planned to achieve a particular aim; 2. a planned undertaking or large-scale engineering task.

example.eng: The research project will take two years.
example.ch: 這項研究計畫將耗時兩年。

example.eng: They are working on a construction project.
example.ch: 他們正在進行一項建設工程。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 prōmissum（許諾，由 prō-「在前、向前」+ mittere「放、送」組成）。作及物動詞時，表示向他人作出口頭保證會做某事，或指某跡象預示著良好的前景。
rows.definition: 1. to assure someone that one will definitely do, give, or arrange something; 2. to give grounds for expecting a particular good result or outcome.

example.eng: He promised to help me with my homework.
example.ch: 他答應幫我做功課。

example.eng: The dark clouds promise rain.
example.ch: 烏雲預示著要下雨了。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 proprius（自己的、特有的、恰當的）。作形容詞時，指符合社會規範、標準、情境要求，或指某事物本身最純正、最嚴格的本義。
rows.definition: 1. conforming to established standards of behavior or etiquette; appropriate; 2. strictly meeting the true definition or character of something.

example.eng: Please use the proper tools for the job.
example.ch: 請使用適合該工作的正確工具。

example.eng: We need a proper vacation, not just a weekend off.
example.ch: 我們需要一個像樣的假期，而不只是週末休息。

rows.analysis: 此字由拉丁語前綴 prō-（向前）與法語或拉丁語根 poser（放置）結合而成。作及物動詞時，指在會議或討論中提出計劃、方案，或特指單膝下跪向伴侶求婚。
rows.definition: 1. to put forward an idea or plan for consideration or action by others; 2. to make an offer of marriage.

example.eng: She proposed a new schedule for the meeting.
example.ch: 她為會議提出了新的時間表。

example.eng: He proposed to her on a romantic beach.
example.ch: 他在浪漫的海灘上向她求婚。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 prōtectus（動詞 prōtegere 的過去分詞，由 prō-「在前」+ tegere「覆蓋」組成）。作及物動詞，指使人或物免受傷害、危險或損害。
rows.definition: 1. to keep safe from harm, injury, or damage.

example.eng: Parents always want to protect their children.
example.ch: 父母總是想保護自己的孩子。

example.eng: Wear sunscreen to protect your skin from the sun.
example.ch: 塗防曬霜以保護皮膚免受陽光傷害。

rows.analysis: 此字由動詞 protect 加上形容詞字尾 -ive 構成。指具有防護功能（如保護裝備），或形容人對他人（如家人、伴侶）表現出過度保護或關切的心理狀態。
rows.definition: 1. intended to protect someone or something; 2. showing a strong desire to protect someone from harm.

example.eng: Workers must wear protective clothing on site.
example.ch: 工人在現場必須穿著防護服。

example.eng: He is very protective of his younger sister.
example.ch: 他對自己的妹妹非常保護。

rows.analysis: 此字源自中古英語 proven，最終源自拉丁語 prōbāre（檢驗、證明）。作及物動詞時，指透過證據或邏輯推導證實某事的真實性，或在實踐中展現出某種特質。
rows.definition: 1. to demonstrate the truth or existence of something by evidence or argument; 2. to turn out to be after a period of time or trial.

example.eng: The police could not prove that he stole the car.
example.ch: 警方無法證明是他偷了車。

example.eng: Her theory proved to be correct.
example.ch: 她的理論被證明是正確的。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 prōvidēre（預見、防範、準備，由 prō-「向前」+ vidēre「看」組成）。作及物動詞時，核心義為預先準備並提供所需之物或服務。
rows.definition: 1. to make available for use; supply; 2. to stipulate in a legal document or contract.

example.eng: The hotel provides free breakfast for all guests.
example.ch: 這家飯店為所有客人提供免費早餐。

example.eng: The contract provides that payment must be made in advance.
example.ch: 合約規定必須預先付款。

rows.analysis: 此字源自中古英語 puddyng，可能借自古法語 boudin（血腸），其根源可追溯至拉丁語 botellus（小腸、香腸）。在現代英語中語義轉化為柔軟、甜美的甜點或類似布丁口感的食品。
rows.definition: 1. a sweet, cooked dessert typically served after the main meal.

example.eng: We had chocolate pudding for dessert.
example.ch: 我們吃巧克力布丁作為甜點。

example.eng: She made a traditional Christmas pudding.
example.ch: 她做了一個傳統的聖誕布丁。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 pompon，最終源自希臘語 pepōn（大瓜）。經由早期英語演變為 pumpkin，專指一種圓形、橙黃色且皮厚的大型葫蘆科植物果實。
rows.definition: 1. a large, round, orange-colored fruit with a thick rind and edible flesh.

example.eng: We carved a scary face into the pumpkin for Halloween.
example.ch: 為了萬聖節，我們在南瓜上雕刻出可怕的臉孔。

example.eng: Pumpkin pie is a traditional Thanksgiving dish.
example.ch: 南瓜派是傳統的感恩節餐點。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 puniss-（動詞 punir 的詞幹），最終源自拉丁語 poenīre（懲罰，源於 poena「刑罰、懲罰」）。作及物動詞，指因某人犯錯、違法或違規而施予懲戒。
rows.definition: 1. to inflict a penalty or sanction on someone for an offense, fault, or crime.

example.eng: The teacher punished the students who cheated on the exam.
example.ch: 老師懲罰了考試作弊的學生。

example.eng: The law punishes those who steal.
example.ch: 法律懲罰偷竊者。

rows.analysis: 此字由及物動詞 punish 加上名詞字尾 -ment 構成，表示懲罰的動作、狀態或結果。構詞完全透明。
rows.definition: 1. the infliction or imposition of a penalty as retribution for an offense.

example.eng: The judge handed down a severe punishment for the crime.
example.ch: 法官對該罪行判處了嚴厲的懲罰。

example.eng: Fear of punishment often deters people from breaking the law.
example.ch: 害怕受罰往往能嚇阻人們違法。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 pūpillus（孤兒、未成年人）及 pupilla（小女孩、眼中的倒影／瞳孔）。在英語中分化為兩個常見義：一是指小學或中學的學生，二是指眼睛中央可調節光線的瞳孔。
rows.definition: 1. a person who is being taught, especially a child in a school; 2. the dark circular opening in the center of the iris of the eye.

example.eng: The school has over five hundred pupils.
example.ch: 這所學校有五百多名學生。

example.eng: Her pupils dilated in the dark room.
example.ch: 在黑暗的房間裡，她的瞳孔擴大了。

rows.analysis: 此字源自中古法語 poupée（洋娃娃、玩具），透過古法語演變並傳入英語，最初可能因小狗可愛如玩具而得名，後來專指未滿一歲的幼犬。
rows.definition: 1. a young dog.

example.eng: They adopted a golden retriever puppy.
example.ch: 他們領養了一隻黃金獵犬幼犬。

example.eng: The little puppy loves to chase its tail.
example.ch: 這隻小狗喜歡追著自己的尾巴跑。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 purpura（紫螺、紫色染料），經由古法語進入英語。作形容詞時，指介於紅色和藍色之間的紫色，或在文學批評中指辭藻過於華麗浮誇的。
rows.definition: 1. of a color intermediate between red and blue; 2. consisting of or characterized by overly elaborate or ornate language.

example.eng: She wore a beautiful purple dress to the party.
example.ch: 她穿了一件漂亮的紫色洋裝去參加派對。

example.eng: The author is known for his purple prose.
example.ch: 這位作家以其辭藻華麗的散文而聞名。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 porpos，由拉丁語 prōpōnere（提出、打算）演變而來。作名詞時，指行事的意圖、目的，或某物被設計出來的實際用途。
rows.definition: 1. the reason for which something is done or created or for which something exists; 2. an intended goal or objective.

example.eng: What is the purpose of your visit?
example.ch: 你來訪的目的是什麼？

example.eng: This tool serves a dual purpose.
example.ch: 這個工具具有雙重用途。

rows.analysis: 此字源自動詞 puzzle（其起源可能與 pose 有關，表示陷入困惑）。作名詞時，指需要動腦解答的謎題、字謎，或指由許多散落小片組合而成的拼圖遊戲。
rows.definition: 1. a game, toy, or problem designed to test ingenuity or knowledge; 2. a difficult question or situation that is hard to understand.

example.eng: He spent the whole afternoon completing a 1000-piece puzzle.
example.ch: 他花了一整個下午完成一千片拼圖。

example.eng: The cause of the accident remains a puzzle.
example.ch: 事故的原因仍然是一個謎。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 quālitās（性質、屬性，源於 quālis「哪種、什麼樣的」）。在現代英語中作名詞，指物品優劣的程度，或指人或事物固有的性格特質、優良品德。
rows.definition: 1. the standard of something as measured against other things of a similar kind; 2. a distinctive attribute or characteristic possessed by someone or something.

example.eng: We focus on producing products of high quality.
example.ch: 我們專注於生產高品質的產品。

example.eng: Patience is an essential quality for a teacher.
example.ch: 耐心是老師不可或缺的特質。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 quantitās（數量，源於 quantus「多少」）。與 quality 相對，專門指可以用數字或度量衡計算的數量、分量或總額。
rows.definition: 1. an amount or number of something.

example.eng: The recipe requires a large quantity of flour.
example.ch: 這食譜需要大量的麵粉。

example.eng: They buy raw materials in large quantities.
example.ch: 他們大批量購買原材料。

rows.analysis: 此字起源於 18 世紀的英語（傳說源自 Dublin 的劇場經理 Richard Daly 打賭創造的無意義新詞，後演變為測驗、考問）。在現代英語中作名詞，指時間較短、題量較小的測驗或益智問答。
rows.definition: 1. a short test of knowledge, often brief and informal.

example.eng: We will have a vocabulary quiz tomorrow.
example.ch: 我們明天要進行單字小考。

example.eng: She won first place in the pub quiz.
example.ch: 她在酒吧問答比賽中獲得第一名。

rows.analysis: 此字為現代透明複合詞，由 rail（鐵軌）與 road（道路）結合而成（美式英語常用詞）。指鋪設鐵軌供火車行駛的運輸系統。
rows.definition: 1. a track or set of tracks made of steel rails along which trains run.

example.eng: The railroad connects the major cities in the region.
example.ch: 這條鐵路連接了該地區的主要城市。

example.eng: He works as an engineer for the railroad company.
example.ch: 他在鐵路公司擔任工程師。

rows.analysis: 此字為現代透明複合詞，由 rail（鐵軌）與 way（道路）結合而成（英式英語偏好用詞）。與 railroad 同義，指鐵路運輸系統。
rows.definition: 1. a track or set of tracks made of steel rails along which trains run.

example.eng: The railway network covers the entire country.
example.ch: 鐵路網覆蓋了全國。

example.eng: She traveled across Europe by railway.
example.ch: 她搭乘鐵路橫跨歐洲。

rows.analysis: 此字為現代透明複合詞，由 rain（雨）與 coat（外套）結合而成。指專門用來在雨天遮擋雨水的外衣。
rows.definition: 1. a long waterproof coat worn to protect the body against rain.

example.eng: Don't forget to take your raincoat; it's starting to drizzle.
example.ch: 別忘了帶雨衣，開始飄毛毛雨了。

example.eng: She put on her yellow raincoat and boots.
example.ch: 她穿上黃色雨衣和靴子。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 range（排、列，源於 rang）。在英語中作名詞，核心義為排列或分佈的區間，引申指變化的範圍、連綿的山脈、射擊靶場或廚房的烹飪爐灶。
rows.definition: 1. the area of variation between upper and lower limits on a particular scale; 2. a large line of mountains; 3. an area for shooting practice or a kitchen stove.

example.eng: The store offers a wide range of products.
example.ch: 這家店提供種類繁多的產品。

example.eng: The Himalayas are a massive mountain range.
example.ch: 喜馬拉雅山脈是一個巨大的山系。

example.eng: They went to the shooting range to practice.
example.ch: 他們去靶場練習射擊。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 rapidus（迅捷的、湍急的，源於 rapere「奪取、抓走」）。作形容詞時，指動作、發展或變化發生得極快、時間短促。
rows.definition: 1. happening in a short time or at a great rate.

example.eng: The city has seen rapid growth over the past decade.
example.ch: 這座城市在過去十年中經歷了迅猛的增長。

example.eng: She made a rapid recovery from her illness.
example.ch: 她從病痛中迅速恢復過來。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 rārus（稀疏的、罕見的）。在現代英語中作形容詞，主要指某事物數量極少而不常見，或專門形容烹調肉類時內部保持鮮嫩紅潤的半熟狀態。
rows.definition: 1. not occurring very often; uncommon; 2. (of meat) cooked only for a short time so that the inside is still red.

example.eng: Giant pandas are a rare species.
example.ch: 大貓熊是稀有物種。

example.eng: I prefer my steak cooked rare.
example.ch: 我喜歡牛排煎得嫩一點（半熟）。

rows.analysis: 此字源自日耳曼語支（比較古英語 ræt、德語 Ratte），屬於日耳曼繼承詞。專指比一般小鼠（mouse）體型更大、尾巴較長的老鼠。
rows.definition: 1. a rodent that resembles a large mouse, typically having a pointed snout and a long tail.

example.eng: A rat ran across the basement floor.
example.ch: 一隻老鼠從地下室地板跑過。

example.eng: The city launched a campaign to control the rat population.
example.ch: 該市發起了一項控制老鼠數量的運動。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古英語 hræðor（hradde 的比較級，意為「更快、更早」），經語義演變在現代英語中作為副詞，表示程度上的「相當」或意願上的「寧可、而不是」。
rows.definition: 1. to a certain extent; fairly or slightly; 2. used to indicate one's preference in a particular situation; instead.

example.eng: It is rather cold outside today.
example.ch: 今天外面天氣相當冷。

example.eng: I would rather stay home than go out in the rain.
example.ch: 我寧願待在家裡，也不想冒雨出去。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 realitās（客觀真實，源於 rēs「事物、物品」）。由形容詞 real 加上名詞字尾 -ity 構成。指客觀存在的事物狀態，或指與幻想相對的真實世界。
rows.definition: 1. the state or quality of having actual existence; 2. the world as it actually exists, rather than as one might imagine or wish it to be.

example.eng: You must face the reality of the situation.
example.ch: 你必須面對現實情況。

example.eng: Her dream of becoming a writer finally became a reality.
example.ch: 她成為作家的夢想終於變成了現實。

rows.analysis: 此字由形容詞 real 加上動詞字尾 -ize 構成。作及物動詞時，核心義為心智上清楚明白某事（意識到），或將抽象的計畫、夢想轉化為現實（實現）。
rows.definition: 1. to become fully aware of something as a fact; understand clearly; 2. to bring into existence; achieve a goal or plan.

example.eng: He didn't realize how late it was.
example.ch: 他沒有意識到已經這麼晚了。

example.eng: She worked hard to realize her childhood dream.
example.ch: 她努力工作以實現童年的夢想。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 receivre，最終源自拉丁語 recipere（re-「回、往回」+ capere「拿、抓」）。作及物動詞時，指主動或被動地取得他人給予之物、訊號，或接待訪客、遭受打擊等。
rows.definition: 1. to be given, presented with, or paid something; 2. to welcome or entertain a guest; to experience or suffer something.

example.eng: Did you receive my email yesterday?
example.ch: 你昨天收到我的電子郵件了嗎？

example.eng: The hotel received our guests warmly.
example.ch: 飯店熱情接待了我們的客人。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 recēns（新鮮的、新近的）。作形容詞時，指發生在不久之前、離現在很近的時間點或時期內的事物。
rows.definition: 1. having happened, begun, or been done not long ago.

example.eng: There have been many recent changes in company policy.
example.ch: 公司政策最近有了許多變動。

example.eng: Have you seen any good movies in recent weeks?
example.ch: 你最近幾週看過什麼好電影嗎？

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 record（回憶、報告），最終源自拉丁語 recordārī（回憶、銘記，源於 cor「心」）。作名詞時（重音在第一音節），指文字或數位形式的記載、最佳運動成績、黑膠唱片或檔案文件。
rows.definition: 1. a thing constituting a piece of evidence about the past, especially an account kept in writing or digital form; 2. the best performance ever achieved in an athletic event; 3. a flat disc bearing a sound recording.

example.eng: The athlete broke the world record in the 100-meter dash.
example.ch: 該運動員打破了一百公尺短跑的世界紀錄。

example.eng: Keep a careful record of all your expenses.
example.ch: 請詳細記錄你的所有開銷。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 recordārī。作為及物動詞（重音在第二音節），指將資訊透過書寫、錄音或錄影等方式保存下來，或在儀器上顯示數據。
rows.definition: 1. to set down in writing or some other permanent form for future reference; 2. to store sound or moving images on tape or disk for later reproduction.

example.eng: She recorded the lecture using her phone.
example.ch: 她用手機錄下了講座的內容。

example.eng: The thermometer recorded a temperature of 40 degrees.
example.ch: 溫度計記錄下了攝氏四十度的溫度。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 recordārī。作不及物動詞時，專門指進行聲音或影像的錄製工作，句型中不帶直接受詞。
rows.definition: 1. to make a recording of sound or video.

example.eng: The band is currently in the studio to record.
example.ch: 樂團目前正在錄音室裡進行錄音。

rows.analysis: 此字由字首 re-（重新、返回）與拉丁語 recuperāre（重新獲得、挽回）結合而成。作及物動詞或不及物動詞（此處對應常見及物用法），指從疾病、疲勞中恢復健康，或找回丟失的財物。
rows.definition: 1. to return to a normal state of health, mind, or strength; 2. to regain possession or control of something stolen, lost, or misplaced.

example.eng: It took him two weeks to recover from the flu.
example.ch: 他花了兩週才從流感中恢復健康。

example.eng: Police managed to recover the stolen painting.
example.ch: 警方設法找回了被竊的畫作。

rows.analysis: 此字由拉丁語 refrigerāre（使變冷，源於 frīgus「寒冷」）衍生的動詞 refrigerate 加上名詞字尾 -or 構成。指利用人工製冷技術保鮮食物的電器設備。
rows.definition: 1. an appliance or compartment that is artificially kept cool for storing food and drink.

example.eng: Put the leftover milk back in the refrigerator.
example.ch: 把剩餘的牛奶放回冰箱裡。

example.eng: We bought a new energy-efficient refrigerator.
example.ch: 我們買了一台新的節能冰箱。

rows.analysis: 此字為 refrigerator 的口語縮寫形式（源自早期品牌名稱 Frigidaire 的簡稱後泛化）。在現代英語中作為標準非正式名詞，指電冰箱。
rows.definition: 1. a refrigerator.

example.eng: Is there anything to eat in the fridge?
example.ch: 冰箱裡有什麼東西可以吃嗎？

example.eng: She stuck a note on the fridge door.
example.ch: 她在冰箱門上貼了一張便條紙。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 refuser，最終源自拉丁語 *refūsāre（拒絕接受，由 re-「回」+ fundere「傾倒」的類推演變而來）。作及物動詞時，指明確表示不接受或拒絕執行某項要求、邀請。
rows.definition: 1. to indicate or show that one is not willing to do, accept, or grant something.

example.eng: He refused to answer their questions.
example.ch: 他拒絕回答他們的問題。

example.eng: She refused the job offer because the salary was too low.
example.ch: 她拒絕了這份工作邀請，因為薪水太低。

rows.analysis: 此字源自古法語 regardier（注視、關心，由 re- + guarder「看、保護」複合而成）。作及物動詞時，核心義為以特定眼光看待或評估某人或某事，亦可指對人的敬重與關切。
rows.definition: 1. to consider or think of someone or something in a specified way; 2. to pay attention to or respect someone.

example.eng: She is regarded as one of the best scientists in her field.
example.ch: 她被視為該領域最優秀的科學家之一。

example.eng: He holds his mentors in high regard.
example.ch: 他對自己的導師們懷有高度的敬意。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 regiōn-（方向、行政區，源於 regere「統治、引導」）。在英語中作名詞，指地球表面的一個地理區域、行政區域，或引申為身體某個部位。
rows.definition: 1. an area or division, especially part of a country or the world having definable characteristics; 2. a broad geographic or bodily area.

example.eng: Wine is produced in this region of the country.
example.ch: 該國的這個地區出產葡萄酒。

example.eng: He felt a sharp pain in the chest region.
example.ch: 他感到胸部區域一陣劇痛。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 rēgulāris（規則的，源於 rēgula「直尺、規則」）。作形容詞時，指按照一定規律反覆發生、符合標準、整齊有序，或指日常生活中的常規事物。
rows.definition: 1. recurring at uniform intervals; done or happening frequently; 2. customary, usual, or normal.

example.eng: Exercise and a regular sleep schedule are important for health.
example.ch: 運動和規律的作息對健康很重要。

example.eng: This is my regular coffee shop.
example.ch: 這是我常去的咖啡店。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 rēiectus（被拋棄的，由 rē-「向後、回」+ iacere「投擲」組成）。作及物動詞時，指堅決拒絕接受某項提議、申請，或身體產生排異反應。
rows.definition: 1. to dismiss as inadequate, inappropriate, or not to be accepted; 2. to refuse to use, accept, or consider.

example.eng: The committee decided to reject the proposal.
example.ch: 委員會決定駁回該提案。

example.eng: His body rejected the transplanted organ.
example.ch: 他的身體對移植的器官產生了排斥反應。

rows.analysis: 此字源自拉丁語 relātus（動詞 referre 的過去分詞，意為「帶回、提及」）。作及物動詞時，早期義為敘述故事，現代更常指將兩者在邏輯或概念上建立關聯。
rows.definition: 1. to give an account of an event or series of events; narrate; 2. to establish a logical or causal connection between two things.

example.eng: He related his adventures in Africa to the audience.
example.ch: 他向聽眾講述他在非洲的冒險經歷。

example.eng: It is difficult to relate economic growth to education levels.
example.ch: 很難將經濟增長與教育水平直接聯繫起來。

rows.analysis: 此字由動詞 relate 加上名詞字尾 -ion 構成（源自拉丁語 relātiōn-）。作名詞時，指人與人、事物與事物之間的相互關係，或指血緣關係的親屬。
rows.definition: 1. the way in which two or more concepts, objects, or people are connected; 2. a blood relative or member of the same family.

example.eng: There is a close relation between diet and health.
example.ch: 飲食與健康之間有著密切的關係。

example.eng: All his friends and relations came to the wedding.
example.ch: 他所有的朋友和親戚都來參加婚禮。
